name: 10805 · New Rochelle, NY
findings: ZIP 10805 (New Rochelle) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10805 (New Rochelle) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 10805 (New Rochelle) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.
